playground.title: POM-JEV Playground
playground.stateHint: Plain text or JSON. It is shared by every question, so the POM caches it once.
playground.empty: Run the request to see the typed answers here.
trace.massHint: Share of the model's probability that went to the answer labels. Low values mean the model wanted to answer something else.
demo.title: POM-JEV plays Snake
demo.body: On every move the plugin sends the board as positions (snake head, body and food, no image) and asks one choice question: up, down, left or right. The highest-probability answer is played.
demo.readyJev: POM-JEV decides every move through the POM.
demo.cause.body: Bit its own body with {score} points.
demo.cause.trapped: Trapped with no safe move, {score} points.
demo.keys: Arrows or WASD steer the snake.
demo.waiting: Start the game to watch POM-JEV decide.
demo.humanNoLog: POM-JEV is watching. Switch to POM-JEV to see its decisions.
demo.badAnswer: The POM did not return a choice for the move.
playground.subtitle: Build typed questions, describe a state, read calibrated answers.
explorer.label: Request explorer
builder.instructionsPlaceholder: What should the model decide about the state?
builder.levels: {count, plural, one {Levels (#), lowest first} other {Levels (#), lowest first}}
builder.jsonHint: The whole request. Edits here update the builder as soon as the JSON is valid.
type.noul: noul: the probability that the answer is yes, from 0 to 1.
type.choice: choice: one option out of 2 to 26, with a probability per option.
type.score: score: a level on an ordered scale of 2 to 10 levels, with the expected level.
issue.badId: Use letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter or _.
issue.duplicateId: Another question already uses this id.
curl.hint: The same request from a terminal. Set POM_API_KEY to one of your POM API keys. Click the text to select it.
